requirements.text: Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
At least 2 years of professional experience in platform engineering, backend development, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or a closely related field.
Experience building and maintaining production-grade software, with an understanding of system reliability, performance optimization, scalability, and security.
Ability to take technical initiatives from problem definition and architecture through implementation, release, and ongoing operational ownership.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound engineering decisions in a rapidly evolving environment.
Comfort working across infrastructure, application services, and external integrations while adapting to changing product needs and technical priorities.
